_comment: character-02 (placeholder id until Mark names him): the second hero, built 2026-10-08 with the one-shot front end (docs/CHARACTER_FRONT_END.md). Values marked TODO-measure are copied from Ennix and set from this figure's pictures and scans tonight.
name: Character02
_asset_prefix: Prefixes every object, material and output file, which games import by name: assembly/Ennix_Character_Review.blend, rigged/Ennix_Rigged.blend, rigged/Ennix_Body_Face.fbx, export/Ennix_Groom.abc, ue5/fit/Ennix_UE5.blend, export/Ennix_UE5.fbx, export/Ennix_Groom_UE5.abc, pose/Ennix_Held_Inspection.blend.

inputs._body_object: The acquired outfit's object inside body-acquisition.blend.

face_proportions._mouth_corner_lift_mm: Millimetres, straight up (+z): his painting's mouth corners sit higher than the conformed head's, so transport_face_proportions.py raises the corner on his right (x < 0) by 2.3 and on his left (x > 0) by 1.0. Where the lift lands (z 1.625 m, |x| 0.03 m) is still in the code.

source_camera._comment: character-02's guidance frame (Qwen-Image-Edit T-pose, 1536x1024), measured by measure_source_frame.py on the front cut-out. No side view could be generated (the model drew busts), so the side origin is the front's and body-left.png is an empty placeholder that paints nothing (body_paint.side_band_abs_x_m = [0, 0]).

_body_lift_m: Raises the acquired body (centred on z=0) so the feet stand on the floor.

body._hands_beyond_abs_x_m: character-02's T-pose arms reach |x| 0.90 m (scan receipt); a 0.18 m hand puts the wrists at about 0.72 m.

body_paint._side_band_abs_x_m: No side picture for character-02: weight is effectively zero (a 1 mm band; [0, 0] would divide by zero), so the front and back paint the sides and the 3D fill the rest.

oral_anatomy._mouth_box_m: |x|, minimum y, z range: occluded head faces here become the mouth interior.
oral_anatomy._neck_m: The head's open neck boundary lies below z 1.64; it is extended down to z 1.43.

neck_overlap._comment: The acquired coat kept a patch of the old neck inside the collar. Faces inside the ellipse (x, y radii) above 1.49 m are cut; the cut rim (above 1.46 m, within |x| 0.2 m) is smoothed, and the binding allows the body to differ from the skinning proxy there.

_neck_weight_blend_m: Head skin weight rises from 0 at z 1.515 to 1 at 1.595; neck_02 takes the rest.

review_views._comment: What the posed review renders look at: the whole figure, the head turn and the expression close-ups.

_todo_measure: neck_weight_blend_m, review_views, body.hands_beyond_abs_x_m (from the prepared body)
oral_anatomy mouth box (check on the conformed head)
body_paint.unmirrored_red: not needed (no one-sided red sash)
_coat: Knee-length navy coat, open at the front: front chains at +-40 deg land on each panel, side chains on the hips, back chains on the tails. Check the coat receipt's hem_found per chain after the build.
